sections.title: 你好，我是 Luoyi
sections.body:
这里是每天都在打游戏的Luoyi（网名 Alaaa），目前在东亚研究和计算机科学的大三在读。每天都在努力制作作品集和学习日语中。游戏各种类型都会尝试，偏爱视觉小说和JRPG。如果有好玩的游戏欢迎随时安利！二次元&游戏&游戏设计相关话题大欢迎！欢迎来找我玩呀｡ 🫶   

这个网站上会放一些关于我喜欢的东西的收藏展示！以及我喜欢的鸡尾酒和塔罗牌抽选！如果有希望出现的新功能欢迎在我的网站上进行留言，或者添加我的联系方式告诉我如何改进！祝你在我的网站玩的开心，拥有美好的一天！ d(`･∀･)b
sections.body_en:
This is Luoyi (a.k.a. Alaaa), who plays games every single day. I'm currently a junior studying East Asian Studies and Computer Science. I'm working hard on my portfolio and studying Japanese every day. I try all kinds of games, but I especially love visual novels and JRPGs. If there's a fun game out there, please recommend it to me anytime! Anything about anime, games, and game design is very welcome! Come find me and hang out｡ 🫶   

On this website I'll be putting up collections of things I like! There's also a draw-a-card feature for my favorite cocktails and tarot cards! If there's a new feature you'd like to see, please leave a message on my website, or add me on social media and tell me how I can improve. I hope you have a great time on my site and a wonderful day! d(`･∀･)b
